aka.zh: 连云港至霍尔果斯国道主干线（G045）

tagline.en: From the Yellow Sea to the Kazakh border, 4,242 km along the old Silk Road
tagline.zh: 自黄海之滨至哈萨克斯坦边境，沿古丝绸之路横贯 4,242 公里

start.en: The Dagang West Road interchange in Lianyun District, Lianyungang, by the port
start.zh: 江苏省连云港市连云区大港西路立交，紧邻连云港港

end.en: The Khorgas border crossing in Xinjiang, where the road continues into Kazakhstan as the A2
end.zh: 新疆霍尔果斯口岸，对侧接哈萨克斯坦 A2 公路

en: G30 crosses China from east to west, from the port of Lianyungang on the Yellow Sea to the border with Kazakhstan at Khorgas. It is the longest east–west expressway in the national network: 4,242 km on the Ministry of Transport's mileage scheme, of which Jiangsu has 237.5 km, Anhui 54.1, Henan 609.7, Shaanxi 367.1, Gansu 1,551.9 and Xinjiang 1,422.2. Before the national numbering it was the Lianyungang–Khorgas national trunk route, G045, the fourth of the 'seven horizontals' in the trunk plan; the Xinjiang government calls it the road of the Eurasian Land Bridge.

From Lianyungang it runs west by Xuzhou into the North China Plain, through Shangqiu, Kaifeng, Zhengzhou and Luoyang, and through Sanmenxia to the Tongguan gap into Shaanxi. It follows the Wei valley by Weinan, Xi'an, Xianyang and Baoji, climbs to Tianshui and Dingxi on the Loess Plateau, and reaches Lanzhou. West of Lanzhou it crosses the Wushaoling and runs the length of the Hexi Corridor by Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan, Jiayuguan, Yumen and Guazhou, enters Xinjiang at Xingxingxia, and goes by Hami, Turpan and Ürümqi along the northern foot of the Tianshan by Changji, Shihezi, Kuytun and Jinghe, over the mountains by Sayram Lake and down the Guozigou to Khorgas.
Between Dingxi and Lanzhou it shares its carriageway with G22. It is part of the Asian Highway network: AH34 from Lianyungang to Xi'an and AH5 from Xi'an to Khorgas, with the whole route also on AH9.
zh: 连霍高速自东向西横贯中国，起于黄海之滨的连云港港，止于中哈边境的霍尔果斯。它是国家高速公路网中最长的东西向高速公路：按交通运输部里程桩号方案全长 4,242 公里，其中江苏 237.5 公里、安徽 54.1 公里、河南 609.7 公里、陕西 367.1 公里、甘肃 1,551.9 公里、新疆 1,422.2 公里。在国家统一编号之前，它是连云港至霍尔果斯国道主干线（G045），即「五纵七横」中的「第四横」；新疆维吾尔自治区政府称之为欧亚大陆桥通道。
出连云港西行，经徐州进入华北平原，经商丘、开封、郑州、洛阳，过三门峡，由潼关入陕。沿渭河谷地经渭南、西安、咸阳、宝鸡，上黄土高原至天水、定西，抵兰州。兰州以西翻越乌鞘岭，纵贯河西走廊，经武威、张掖、酒泉、嘉峪关、玉门、瓜州，在星星峡进入新疆；经哈密、吐鲁番、乌鲁木齐，沿天山北麓经昌吉、石河子、奎屯、精河，翻山经赛里木湖、下果子沟，抵霍尔果斯。
定西至兰州段与 G22 青兰高速共线。它也是亚洲公路网的组成部分：连云港至西安段为亚洲公路 34 号线，西安至霍尔果斯段为亚洲公路 5 号线，全线同属亚洲公路 9 号线。

en: The hardest piece in Gansu was the Wushaoling, where the road crosses from the Lanzhou basin into the Hexi Corridor at an average altitude of about 2,400 m, at the meeting of the Inner Mongolian, Loess and Tibetan plateaus. The Yongdeng–Gulang section, 145.1 km for 80 km/h, was finished there in 2013 with a group of five tunnels — Wushaoling, Anyuan, Fu'erwan, Gaoling and Gulang — 21.9 km long in all. The Gansu transport department said it would end the snowbound jams on the pass in winter and save more than 40 minutes.

At the far end, the Sayram Lake–Guozigou section, 56.2 km and opened in 2011, was Xinjiang's first mountain expressway, bridges and tunnels end to end: 5 extra-large bridges, 19 large ones and 5 tunnels, among them the Sayram Lake tunnel, at the time the longest road tunnel in Xinjiang. The Guozigou, a 28 km ravine on the northern Silk Road, had been notorious for avalanches, floods and landslides. Its centrepiece is the Guozigou Bridge, a cable-stayed bridge with a steel-truss deck, 700 m long with a 360 m main span, 200 m above the valley floor on towers of 209 m and 215.5 m; it used 17,000 tonnes of steel and was the first steel-truss cable-stayed road bridge in China.

Much of the eastern half has since been rebuilt to eight lanes: in Henan, Zhengzhou–Luoyang in 2012, Lankao–Liujiang in 2013, and Luoyang–Sanmenxia and Lankao–Shangqiu in 2015; in Shaanxi, mostly by widening the old road on both sides, Tongguan–Lintong, 116.3 km, in 2013, and finally the original Xi'an–Lintong road, which had become the four-lane bottleneck between eight-lane sections, in November 2015 — from then G30 was eight lanes across the whole Guanzhong plain. In Xinjiang the Xiaocaohu–Ürümqi section, originally the 1998 Turpan–Ürümqi–Dahuangshan road, was rebuilt to eight lanes for 120 km/h; its civil works were finished in September 2020.
zh: 甘肃境内最难的一段在乌鞘岭：道路在这里由兰州盆地翻入河西走廊，地处内蒙古高原、黄土高原、青藏高原三大高原交汇地带，平均海拔约 2,400 米。永登至古浪段全长 145.1 公里，设计时速 80 公里，2013 年随乌鞘岭、安远、福尔湾、高岭、古浪五座隧道组成的隧道群建成，隧道群全长 21.9 公里。甘肃省交通运输厅称，此后乌鞘岭冬季因积雪造成的大堵车将有效消除，通行时间比翻越乌鞘岭缩短 40 多分钟。

最西端的赛里木湖至果子沟口段全长 56.2 公里，2011 年通车，是新疆第一条桥隧相连的山区高速公路，共有特大桥 5 座、大桥 19 座、隧道 5 座，其中赛里木湖隧道是当时全疆最长的公路隧道。果子沟全长 28 公里，是历史上的丝绸之路北道，过去雪崩、洪水、山体滑坡时有发生。全段的标志是果子沟大桥：双塔双索面钢桁梁斜拉桥，全长 700 米，主跨 360 米，桥面距谷底约 200 米，两座主塔分别高 209 米和 215.5 米，用钢 1.7 万吨，是全国第一座钢桁梁公路斜拉桥。

东半段此后多已扩建为八车道：河南境内，郑洛段 2012 年，兰考至刘江段 2013 年，洛阳至三门峡段与兰考至商丘段 2015 年；陕西境内大多采用在旧路两侧拼接加宽的办法，潼关至临潼段 116.3 公里 2013 年投入试运行，最后是夹在八车道路段之间、已成「卡脖子」路段的西临高速，于 2015 年 11 月完成扩建——此后连霍高速陕西境八车道横贯关中。新疆境内，原为 1998 年吐乌大高等级公路的小草湖至乌鲁木齐段改扩建为设计时速 120 公里的八车道高速公路，土建工程于 2020 年 9 月完工。

en: The first piece was a short road to the Terracotta Army. In September 1985 Singapore's prime minister, Lee Kuan Yew, was held up in traffic on his way to Lintong, and told the national leadership in Beijing that the terracotta warriors were a wonder of the world but the road from Xi'an to Lintong was quite inadequate; in October the State Council said that the Xi'an–Lintong road should be fixed first. The Xi'an–Lintong Expressway, 23.9 km, was begun on 25 December 1986 and opened on 27 December 1990 — Shaanxi's first expressway, and the first in western China.

In Henan, Zhengzhou–Kaifeng, 81 km, opened on 26 December 1994 and Zhengzhou–Luoyang, 106.4 km, on 28 December 1995. Shangqiu–Kaifeng followed in December 2001 and the Anhui section on 1 July 2002. Gansu began its first section, Chankou–Liugouhe, in 1999, and by the end of 2011 most of the province was expressway; the Wushaoling tunnels, opened on 30 July 2013, were its last bottleneck. Chinese Wikipedia records the whole route as open on 31 December 2014.

Xinjiang finished later still. Until 2019 the road through Turpan ran through the town and its scenic areas and was below expressway standard; the bypass from Turpan to Xiaocaohu, 106.6 km, opened on 1 March 2019, and the Tianshan News reported that only then was the road from Xingxingxia to Khorgas expressway throughout.

On 1 February 2013 a lorry illegally carrying fireworks exploded on the Yichang Bridge in Mianchi county, Sanmenxia, bringing down about 80 m of one carriageway and sending vehicles into the valley below. Thirteen people were killed and nine injured. The Henan investigation found that the lorry had no licence for dangerous goods and was carrying illegally made explosives; twenty people faced prosecution.
zh: 最早的一段，是一条通往兵马俑的短路。1985 年 9 月，新加坡总理李光耀前往临潼参观兵马俑，途中遭遇长时间堵车；到北京后，他对国家领导人说，秦兵马俑是世界的奇迹，可西安到临潼的公路实在是太不适应了。同年 10 月，国务院提出「首先要把临潼至西安的道路修好」。西临高速公路全长 23.9 公里，1986 年 12 月 25 日奠基动工，1990 年 12 月 27 日建成通车，是陕西第一条高速公路，也是中国西部第一条高速公路。

河南境内，郑州至开封段 81 公里于 1994 年 12 月 26 日通车，郑洛高速 106.4 公里于 1995 年 12 月 28 日通车。商开高速 2001 年 12 月通车，安徽段 2002 年 7 月 1 日通车。甘肃 1999 年开工第一段巉口至柳沟河，至 2011 年底境内基本实现高速化；2013 年 7 月 30 日通车的乌鞘岭隧道群是最后一个瓶颈。据中文维基百科，连霍高速于 2014 年 12 月 31 日全线通车。
新疆完成得更晚。2019 年以前，吐鲁番一段老路穿过市区和景区，达不到高速公路标准；吐鲁番至小草湖新线 106.6 公里于 2019 年 3 月 1 日开通，天山网报道称，到这时连霍高速新疆段从星星峡到霍尔果斯才实现真正意义上的全程高速。
2013 年 2 月 1 日，一辆非法运输烟花爆竹的货车在三门峡市渑池县义昌大桥上爆炸，大桥半幅桥面约 80 米坍塌，车辆坠落桥下，造成 13 人死亡、9 人受伤。河南省事故调查认定，该车不具备危险货物运输资质，运载的是违法生产的烟火药剂和烟花爆竹；20 名相关责任人被采取司法措施。

en: No cost for the whole route has been published. The provinces report their own: Gansu put the cumulative investment in its section, which it counts as 1,590 km, at ¥43.69 billion over the fourteen years from 1999 to 2013. Within that, the approved estimate for Yongdeng–Gulang over the Wushaoling was ¥5.869 billion. In Xinjiang, the Sayram Lake–Guozigou section cost ¥2.39 billion.

The Turpan–Xiaocaohu bypass opened in 2019 was Xinjiang's first commercially operated expressway — built by a company to be repaid from its own tolls rather than as a government toll-loan road — and was built by Xinjiang Communications Investment. It was also the first expressway in Xinjiang to take tolls by mobile phone.
zh: 全线总造价未见公布，各省自报：甘肃称其境内路段（按甘肃口径 1,590 公里）自 1999 年至 2013 年的 14 年间累计完成投资 436.9 亿元；其中翻越乌鞘岭的永登至古浪段概算投资 58.69 亿元。新疆境内，赛里木湖至果子沟口段总投资 23.9 亿元。
2019 年开通的吐鲁番至小草湖段是新疆第一条经营性高速公路——由企业投资、以自身收费回收，而非政府还贷公路——由新疆交通投资有限责任公司建设。它也是新疆首条开通手机移动支付通行费的高速公路。

why.en: No route-wide total is published. G30 was built province by province between 1986 and 2019, and costs are reported by province or section; the published ones are listed below.
why.zh: 未公布全线总造价。连霍高速于 1986—2019 年间由各省分段修建，造价按省或路段公布；已公布者见下。

why.en: No breakdown has been published for the route or for any province. The one section whose financing model is stated is Turpan–Xiaocaohu (2019), Xinjiang's first commercially operated expressway, built by Xinjiang Communications Investment (Tianshan News, 4 March 2019).
why.zh: 全线及各省的出资构成均未公布。唯一说明了投融资方式的是吐鲁番至小草湖段（2019 年），为新疆第一条经营性高速公路，由新疆交通投资有限责任公司建设（天山网，2019 年 3 月 4 日）。

timeline.en: The Xi'an–Lintong Expressway, Shaanxi's first, opens on 27 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 27 日，陕西第一条高速公路西临高速通车。
12 月 26 日，郑州至开封段 81 公里通车。
12 月 28 日，郑洛高速 106.4 公里通车。

timeline.en: The Anhui section opens on 1 July.
The Guozigou Bridge and the Sayram Lake–Guozigou section open on 30 September; most of Gansu is expressway by 21 December.
timeline.zh: 9 月 30 日，果子沟大桥及赛果高速通车；12 月 21 日，甘肃境内基本实现高速化。

timeline.en: A fireworks lorry explodes on the Yichang Bridge on 1 February, killing 13; the Wushaoling tunnels open on 30 July.
timeline.zh: 2 月 1 日，义昌大桥运输烟花爆竹货车爆炸，13 人遇难；7 月 30 日，乌鞘岭隧道群通车。

timeline.en: The whole route is recorded as open on 31 December.
The Turpan–Xiaocaohu bypass opens on 1 March, making the Xinjiang section expressway throughout.
timeline.zh: 3 月 1 日，吐鲁番至小草湖段开通，新疆段实现全程高速。

timeline.en: Civil works on the eight-lane rebuild of Xiaocaohu–Ürümqi are finished in September.
timeline.zh: 9 月，小草湖至乌鲁木齐段八车道改扩建土建工程完工。
